answer: Build a reputation bridge that fakes cannot cross cheaply. A newcomer seeking paid work must first complete three supervised trial jobs under a single sponsor identity, each signed off separately, and post a 450 POA bridge bond held for 90 days. If any trial is copied or two identities share a sponsor route, both bonds are burned and both are barred for 200 days, so one hundred fakes risk 45,000 POA. A saffron trader with a real delivery record, or a lantern keeper tending one honest route, crosses that bridge once and keeps crossing it on merit alone.
